tech_stack.frontend: Next.js 16.2.4 App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, shadcn 4.x on Base UI (not Radix), TanStack Query + Table, Zustand (access token in-memory only, user/isAuthenticated persisted), react-hook-form + zod
tech_stack.backend: FastAPI, sibling repo ../urgent-printers-backend (async SQLModel + PostgreSQL). Not driven through the browser — read app/api/v1/routes/admin/ and app/schemas/ for request/response contracts, and app/core/permissions.py for the RBAC strings a plan's alternate/error paths may depend on.

brand.voice_persona: clear, efficient, plain-spoken — a colleague walking a new staff member through a workflow, not a sales pitch

_notes._generated: Set up as part of the QA/docs/demo-video pipeline. See ../pipeline/README.md for the module map and ../.claude/commands/qa/*.md for the prompts that read this file.
_notes.brand: primary_color/accent_color are src/app/globals.css's real --color-primary / --color-primary-hover tokens. No logo.png exists yet in public/ — the renderer falls back to a text-only brand card until one is added.
_notes.auth: The access token lives only in memory (never localStorage), so capture.js's seedDefaultContextStorage() can restore user/isAuthenticated for a Lighthouse checkpoint but not a live token. A post-login final_state checkpoint may get redirected — see ../pipeline/README.md's 'Known per-app wrinkles'.
_notes.field_style: White background / dark text matches the default admin theme. If a demo is captured in dark mode, override this per-run.
_notes.tts: voice_id is unfilled — pick a voice from the ElevenLabs dashboard before the first /qa:narrate-feature run.
_notes.llm: null routes every AI module to Claude, which needs no local infrastructure. See ../pipeline/README.md's 'AI models' section before changing this.
_notes.urls: production is unset — this app has no public production URL yet (staff-only, internal). Fill in once one exists; nothing downstream requires it before then.
